nodes.name: NGQDs synthesis
nodes.procedure: Pyrene was refluxed in concentrated HNO3 at 80°C for 12 h with mass concentration of 12.5 g l^-1. The resulted mixture was diluted and filtered through a 0.22 μm microporous membrane to obtain 1,3,6-trinitropyrene. Then 1,3,6-trinitropyrene (360 mg), sodium bicarbonate (232 mg) and urea (280 mg), were dispersed in water (60 mL) under ultrasonication at 0°C for 2 h. After that, the suspension was transferred into a Teflon-lined autoclave (100 mL) and heated at 200°C for 10 h. The resulted suspension was filtered and dialyzed (retained molecular weight: 3500 Da) to remove sodium salt and unfused small molecules and dried to obtain the NGQDs powder.
nodes.source_text: Synthesis of amino-functionalized GQDs (NGQDs) Typically, pyrene was refluxed... dried to obtain the NGQDs powder.

nodes.name: NGQDs self-assembly to helical fibers
nodes.procedure: Such prepared NGQD powder was dispersed in water with concentration of 0.17 mg mL^-1 under sonication for 30 min. Then the pH of the NGQDs suspension was adjusted with citric acid-sodium citrate buffer (0.1 M) to 9.5 under stirring, and then left standing for 72 h to obtain 1D helical fibers. All the assemblies were collected by centrifugation and dried at 60°C.
nodes.source_text: Self-assembly of NGQDs to form varied architectures Such prepared NGQD powder was dispersed... dried at 60°C.

nodes.name: Co chelation and phosphidation to Co-PN-C600
nodes.procedure: The Co(C5H7O2)2 stock solution (1 mg mL^-1) was firstly prepared by dissolving Co(C5H7O2)2·xH2O in water. Then 1D helical fiber (10 mg) and the stock solution (5 mL) were mixed with water (25 mL) under stirring for 10 min to obtain a homogeneous suspension before transfer to a Teflon-lined autoclave and heated at 80°C for 3 h. After cooling down, the suspension was freeze-dried. Phosphidation was conducted in a tube furnace under slow argon flow with NaH2PO2 (upstream) as phosphorus source (Co:P molar ratio 1:6). Temperature was raised to 600°C at 10°C min^-1 ramp rate and held for 3 h to obtain Co-PN-C600. Products were leached in 1 M H2SO4 for 3 h at 80°C followed by thorough washing.

nodes.evidence_snippet: Analysis using inductively coupled plasma mass spectroscopy (ICP-MS) showed that Co-PN-C600 (4.41 wt%) and Co–N4–C (4.65 wt%) had similar cobalt content (Supplementary Table 2).

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS survey confirms C, N, P, Co in Co-PN-C600; C 1s shows sp2 C-C (284.8 eV), C-P (285.4 eV), C-N (286.5 eV); N 1s shows pyridinic N (397.6 eV), Co-N (398.7 eV); P 2p shows P-Co (130.5 eV), P-C/P-N (132.5 eV), P-O (133.5 eV); Co 2p peaks at 780.8/797.2 eV for Co-N/Co-P shifted lower vs Co-N4-C.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The XPS survey spectra confirm the existence of C, N, P and Co. The deconvoluted C 1s spectra shows sp2 C–C, C–P, C–N peak at 284.8 eV, 285.4 eV and 286.5 eV, respectively... The P 2p spectra displays three peaks at 130.5, 132.5 and 133.5 eV... As depicted in Co 2p spectrum, the peaks at 780.8 and 797.2 eV could be associated with Co–N/Co–P bond.

nodes.characterization_summary: Co K-edge XANES shows Co-PN-C600 valence between Co foil and CoO; FT-EXAFS shows Co-P at 1.8 Å and Co-N at 1.4 Å scattering paths with no Co-Co at 2.2 Å, confirming atomic dispersion and Co-P2N2 coordination.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Co K-edge X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) was employed... the extended X-ray absorption fine structure (FT-EXAFS) of Co-PN/C600 showed two main peaks at ca. 1.8 Å and 1.4 Å assigned to the Co–P and Co–N scattering paths.

nodes.characterization_summary: Atomic-resolution EELS evidences Co-P2N2 motif with Co atom surrounded by two N and two P atoms in para position.
nodes.evidence_snippet: We further performed atomic-resolution EELS to evidence the accurate configuration of Co-P2N2 motif... the atomically dispersed Co atom is surrounded by two N (green) and two P (blue) atoms in para position.

nodes.characterization_summary: Wavelet transform EXAFS plots of Co-PxN4-x-C (x=0-3) show maximum intensities at 4.7, 5.8, 5.2, 4.9 Å respectively, differing from Co foil (6.8 Å) and Co2O3 (6.3 Å).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The wavelet transform spectra indicate that Co–PxN4-x (x = 0-3) exhibit maximum intensities at approximately 4.7, 5.8, 5.2, and 4.9 Å, respectively, which differed significantly from those of Co foil (6.8 Å) and Co2O3 (6.3 Å) (Fig. 3g–j).
